thm:recognition.statement: Finitely generated groups quasi-isometric to a finitely generated virtually polycyclic group are virtually polycyclic.
thm:recognition.conditions: No algebraic assumption on comparison H beyond finite generation.
thm:recognition.constants_and_limits: Existential recognition,not an algorithm on finite graphs/presentations;no finite radius threshold or reconstruction cost.

cor:lattice-recognition.statement: The recognized group has a finite-index subgroup realized as a uniform solvable Lie lattice.
cor:lattice-recognition.conditions: Source lattice in connected simply connected solvable Lie group;H finitely generated.
cor:lattice-recognition.constants_and_limits: Ambient Lie group may change;not isomorphism with original lattice or equality of original Lie models.

thm:bounded-height.statement: Every fixed-distortion self quasi-isometry has globally bounded height error relative to a finite linear slope group.
thm:bounded-height.conditions: Connected simply connected real-triangulable unimodular G;fixed metric andnorm;canonical ADJOINT-character quotient W.
thm:bounded-height.constants_and_limits: Finite group chosen BEFORE K,C;B dependsG,K,C butnotF orpoint. W0 nilpotentcasevacuous;no explicit usableB.

lem:cartan-model.statement: Nilpotent N andD give a surjective submersion N semidirectD toG.
lem:cartan-model.conditions: Generalized real Cartan weights;N generated bynonzero weightspaces.
lem:cartan-model.constants_and_limits: NcapD neednottrivial,central ordiscrete;kernel retained. N1 iffGnilpotent.

lem:path-packing.statement: Height-constrained O(r)-length paths have atmost polynomial(r) exp(rP(E)) separatedendpoints.

lem:polynomial-path-packing.statement: Paths with uniformly bounded intermediate heights have polynomial separatedendpoint count.

lem:fixed-sheet-packing.statement: Fixed-D-position N-Haar volume yields uniform separatedpoint lower count.

lem:lift-multiplicity.statement: N-volume hiddenover onefixed-radiusGball is atmostC(1+T)^b exp(cH).

lem:backward-recurrence.statement: Nested positive-mass starting sets retain a fixed sequence of successful groupincrements.

cor:restricted-products.statement: Successful restricted parameter paths have subexponential measure and imagevolume.

lem:lipschitz-pairs.statement: Coarse inverse maps can be uniformly smoothed to equi-Lipschitz coarse-inversepairs.

lem:pair-sections.statement: Normalized map-pair sections are compact metrizable and carry continuous recenteredrightactions.

lem:cohomological-slope.statement: Fixed ergodic invariant probability gives homomorphic height slope and compact coboundaryapproximations.

lem:stationary-volume.statement: Averaged slope obeysP(piE)<=P(lE) andfactorsas invertibleA pi.

lem:inverse-coupling.statement: Forward compact coboundary slopeA transfers exactlyA^-1 to a finite nonzero inverse invariant measure.
lem:inverse-coupling.conditions: ProductHaar coupling onOmega andtwo compact sections.

lem:profile-interior-slack.statement: Strict interiorheightmargin survives allowed enlargedN suffixconjugation.

lem:occupation-invariance.statement: Large-chart occupation-law limits are invariant under normalizedG action.

lem:profile-convex-increments.statement: Every supported limiting profile has horizontalincrements in convexhull of finite slopes.

lem:profile-segment-volume.statement: Supported profile cannot decrease segment support-volume exponentP.

lem:affinity-criterion.statement: Convexincrements pluswhole-segmentvolume lowerbound force one affine profileA pi+b.
